[CREATURE:SHALSWAR]
	[CREATURE_CLASS:ALL_CREATURES][DESCRIPTION:A small reptile with a mouth full of razor-sharp teeth. The shalswar stands on two taloned legs, leaving its arms free to be used as weapons. The animal stands at a strange angle, somewhat like a flightless bird. Unfortunately it is rather small, so instead of hunting giant mammals, it has to rely on killing vermin. In big numbers Shalswars are not to be underestimated however.]
